reason: EUR 120 is a lot when my phone already does the alarm and the weather for free. I like the idea of getting the phone out of the bedroom, but I would not pay that on a pre-order for something I cannot hold yet.
objection: I know I scroll too much, but I am not sure a EUR 120 clock is what fixes it. I would probably keep the phone next to me anyway 'just in case' and then I have paid for a second alarm clock. It is also a brand-new company and I would be paying before anyone I know has used one.
would_change_my_mind: A price nearer EUR 70 to 80, or reviews from real owners showing they actually left the phone in another room after a few weeks.
